entities.summary: Larry King was an American TV and radio host, author, and spokesman. He was a WMBM radio interviewer in the Miami area in the 1950s and 1960s. Beginning in 1978, King gained national prominence as host of The Larry King Show, an all-night nationwide call-in radio program heard over the Mutual Broadcasting System. From 1985 to 2010, he hosted the nightly interview television program Larry King Live on CNN. King hosted Larry King Now from 2012 to 2020, which aired on Hulu, Ora TV, and RT America. He hosted Politicking with Larry King, a weekly political talk show, on the same three channels from 2013 to 2020.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent television host and radio personality, Larry King facilitated conversations with world leaders, celebrities, and influential figures, providing a platform for their stories to reach a global audience. His shows helped shape public perception of historical events and cultural icons.
